steps.title: Build Docker image
steps.instruction: In the directory containing the provided Dockerfile, execute the command `docker build -t repro .` to create the reproducibility container image.

steps.title: Start container interactively
steps.instruction: Run `docker run -i -t repro` to launch an interactive terminal session inside the newly built container.

steps.title: Execute reproduction script
steps.instruction: Within the running container, invoke the script `./doAll.sh` to run the software experiments and build the LaTeX report.
